kyc.signed_out: Sign in first. Then come back to this page to verify your identity.
form.errors_title: Please correct these and try again
status.title: Your verification
status.rejected: Your last submission was not accepted.
status.revoked: Your verification was withdrawn. Contact support.
status.expected: Our team usually reviews a submission within {hours} hours. You will get a notification.
status.attempts_left: You can submit {n} more times in 30 days.
status.no_attempts: You have used every attempt for now. You can submit again later.
reason.image_unreadable: An image was blurred, cut off or too dark. Take each photo again in good light, with the whole document in the frame and no glare.
reason.selfie_mismatch: Your selfie did not clearly match the photo on your document. Take the selfies again facing the camera, without glasses, a hat or a mask.
reason.liveness_failed: The second selfie did not show the action we asked for. Take it again while you do the action.
reason.document_expired: The document has expired. Submit a valid NID or passport.
reason.details_mismatch: The details you typed do not match the document. Type the number, name and date of birth exactly as printed.
reason.underage: You must be 18 or older to buy and sell on TrustBazaar.
reason.duplicate_identity: This document is already linked to another account. If that account is yours, sign in to it; otherwise contact support.
reason.other: We could not verify this identity. Contact support.
intro.lead: Before you start, have these ready. It takes about five minutes.
intro.document: Your national ID card (NID) or your passport.
intro.both_sides: For an NID, photos of both sides; for a passport, the photo page.
intro.selfie: A camera on this device for two live selfies. A saved photo cannot be used for the selfies.
intro.light: Good light and no glare on the document.
intro.whole: The whole document in the frame, with every corner visible.
intro.time: Nothing is sent until the last step, and you can take each photo again.
intro.privacy: Your images are encrypted and seen only by our verification team. We use them only to verify your identity and prevent fraud, never for marketing.
details.number_invalid.nid: Enter the NID number as printed: 10, 13 or 17 digits.
details.number_invalid.passport: Enter the passport number as printed: one or two letters and 7 or 8 digits.
details.name: Full name
details.name_hint: Exactly as printed on the document.
details.name_invalid: Enter your full name as printed.
details.dob_invalid: Enter a real date of birth, as printed on the document.
image.doc_front.title: Front of your NID
image.doc_front.hint: Place the card on a dark, flat surface. Fill the frame with the whole card, with no glare on the photo.
image.doc_back.title: Back of your NID
image.doc_back.hint: Turn the card over and take the back the same way.
image.passport_photo_page.title: Passport photo page
image.passport_photo_page.hint: Open the passport at the page with your photo. Fill the frame with the whole page, with no glare.
image.selfie_neutral.title: Selfie
image.selfie_neutral.hint: Look straight at the camera with a neutral face, in good light, without glasses, a hat or a mask.
image.selfie_action.title: Selfie with the action
image.selfie_action.hint: Do the action shown above, and take the photo while you do it.
action.turn_head_left: turn your head to the left
action.turn_head_right: turn your head to the right
capture.problem.denied: The camera is blocked for this site. To allow it, open the site settings from the icon next to the address bar, allow the camera, and press Start the camera again.
capture.problem.missing: No camera was found on this device.
capture.problem.failed: The camera could not start. Close other apps that use it and try again.
capture.file_offer: You can also choose a photo of the document from this device.
capture.selfie_needs_camera: The selfies must be taken live with the camera; a saved photo cannot be used. Use a device with a camera if this one has none.
capture.choose_file: Choose a photo of the document
capture.file_type: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
capture.too_large: This photo is larger than 10 MB. Take it again or choose a smaller one.
capture.unreadable: This photo could not be read. Take it again.
capture.required: This photo is missing. Take it again.
review.once: When you send, your images and details go to our verification team. They are kept only in this page until then.
submit.challenge_expired: The time for the action ran out. A new action is shown: take this selfie again.
submit.limit: You have used every attempt for now. You can submit again later.
submit.not_allowed: Your verification status has changed. The page now shows the current status.
sent.title: What you sent
